<h2>Research Talks</h2>

<p style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#6c757d;margin-bottom:1.5rem;">
Invited presentations on core research themes: trustworthy AI, neural-symbolic learning, zero/few-shot generalization, and efficient temporal models.
</p>

<div style="border-left:3px solid #2d7dd2;padding:0.6rem 0 0.6rem 1rem;margin-bottom:1rem;">
<div style="font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:700;color:#6c757d;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;">April 2026 · Homerton College, University of Cambridge</div>
<p style="font-size:0.92rem;margin:0.3rem 0 0;">
<strong>From Accuracy to Guarantees: Neuro-Symbolic Intelligence and Cyber-Graph Architectures for Safe, Real-Time Battery Systems</strong><br>
Advanced Battery Manufacturing Workshop · Co-organised by EU Horizon Europe projects BATTwin, AM4BAT, and BatCAT.<br>
<span style="font-size:0.85rem;color:#6c757d;">How AI can move beyond average-case accuracy toward provable safety in real-time battery systems — combining learning-based models with structured constraint enforcement to enable adaptive intelligence while ensuring only safe actions are possible by design.</span>
</p>
</div>

<div style="border-left:3px solid #2d7dd2;padding:0.6rem 0 0.6rem 1rem;margin-bottom:1rem;">
<div style="font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:700;color:#6c757d;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;">January 2026 · University of Limerick</div>
<p style="font-size:0.92rem;margin:0.3rem 0 0;">
<strong>From Seen to Unseen: Learning Beyond Data Abundance</strong><br>
CRT-AI ML Week 2026, hosted by Prof. Tiziana Margaria.<br>
<span style="font-size:0.85rem;color:#6c757d;">Zero-Shot Learning, knowledge-driven generalization, energy-efficient AI — why scaling data and parameters is not enough for rare and safety-critical scenarios.</span>
</p>
</div>

<div style="border-left:3px solid #2d7dd2;padding:0.6rem 0 0.6rem 1rem;margin-bottom:1rem;">
